text:
I'm sorry about this. Having to chase it twice is frustrating.

Under our policy, refunds are issued within **5 business days** of the return reaching our warehouse. Once issued, they take **5-10 business days** to appear on a card, or **3-5 business days** for a digital wallet. So depending on when the parcel arrived and how you paid, the money may still be in transit. I can't see your order's return or refund status from here, so I can't confirm which stage it's at.

Since you've already asked twice, I can escalate this to a Support Lead to check the refund status. Please send me your order number and the date you dropped off the return. You can also take Leafy store credit instead, which is issued instantly, if you'd prefer that.
